_about: 149 Morning Sun Ave, Mill Valley CA (unincorporated Marin County, APN 051-091-11): the deck AS BUILT, reconciled from the owner's sketches (IMG_5692 elevation, IMG_5693 plan), 27 site photos (26 Oct 2026), the 2018 design (M. Tepperman, A1/A2, 2-21-18) and the house as-built sheets (M. Mijangos, A-1.10/A-1.20, 2026). One-off job (PCG for Adam Messner): nothing here feeds GSX defaults. Every value carries its source; 'verify' marks what the owner must measure or photograph before submittal. Units: inches unless noted. Plan frame: origin = deck corner at the HOUSE line on the north edge; X along the house toward the SOUTH; Y away from the house toward the EAST (the rear lot line).

site.address: 149 Morning Sun Ave, Mill Valley, CA 94941
site.jurisdiction: Marin County CDA Building & Safety (unincorporated; Almonte / Tamalpais Area Community Plan)
site.owners: Adam Messner and Allison Rhodes Messner, Trustees of The 2017 Messner Family Trust
site.codes: 2025 California codes (eff. 2026-01-01, Marin Ord. 3838); 2025 CWUIC Ch. 5 (Marin UWI area)
site.seismic: SDC D (ASCE 7-22 SDS 1.31 / SD1 1.30, default site class); CRC SDC D2
site.fhsz: LRA non-wildland (not VHFHSZ); inside the county Urban-Wildland Interface layer -> CWUIC Ch. 5 applies

deck.edge_definition: owner's dimensions to the deck edge (fascia face vs. framing not stated) - verify
deck.surface_above_grade: about 10'-1" at the house to 12'-3" at the outer edge on the 2018 section; owner post lengths 9' (inner) and 11' (outer) + beam + joist + board give about 10'-9" / 12'-9" above the pier tops - verify one height with a tape

decking.field: TimberTech Advanced PVC, Vintage collection, Weathered Teak, 5.5" boards, parallel to the house, hidden clips
decking.border: a second, darker brown Vintage board (double picture frame on the east edge and south end, mitered corners, plus breaker boards) - color to confirm with the owner
decking.fascia: PVC fascia, two boards high, face-fastened
decking.wui: SFM 8110-2042:0001 (Class A) and 8170-2042:0504 cover the 5.5" board only; CCRR-0101: joists 16" o.c. max

joists.species: PT DF (2018 spec: P.T.D.F.; verify grade stamp)

ledger.fastening: 1/2"-5/8" bolts or lags with ~2-1/2" square plate washers, about one per joist bay (2018: 1/2" lags @16" staggered / (2) 1/2" MB @16" / SDWS - conflicting) - verify type, length, spacing
ledger.hangers: Simpson LUS210Z at every joist, Simpson SD connector screws
ledger.flashing: not visible - verify (photo); 2025 CWUIC 504.7.3.1 also wants 6" vertical metal flashing at the deck-to-wall line
ledger.support: bolted to the band of the MAIN floor, which cantilevers ~2'-9" past the basement wall below (house sheets A-1.10, soffit visible under the ledger IMG_5671/5677/5678) - CRC R507.9.1.2 -> engineering

beams.name: B1 inner (intermediate)
beams.species: PT DF or redwood (no incising seen) - verify
beams.detail: the house-side joists hang from a continuous header sitting on this beam (LUS-type hangers, A35/LTP4-type clips header-to-beam, IMG_5676)
beams.y_basis: inferred: the north strip's 90" depth sits on this line; 2018 design had it at 103.75" - verify (tape from the house to the beam face)

beams.name: B2 outer
beams.detail: joists bear on top, Simpson H2.5A at each joist (about 10 seen, IMG_5673/5675), A35-type clips at the blocking (about 9)
beams.y_basis: photos: about 1-2 ft inside the fascia; 2018 design 189.75" from the house face - verify

framing.beam_splices: at least one butt splice centered over a 6x6 (IMG_5676, ~2-3/4" bearing each end) - verify every splice is over a post
framing.blocking: solid blocking over both beams + one continuous row at mid-span of the house-side bay (IMG_5670/5676)

stations_x_in.note: NOT dimensioned anywhere: 6 inner/outer pairs share stations along the deck (14/13 ... 4/3, south to north); post 2 (outer) at the jog X~69; post 1 (inner) at the north end under the stair start. Average ~91" o.c. if even - the owner must measure every post-to-post spacing

posts.caps: black-painted plate on the beam face with a galvanized leg on the post (CCQ/ECCQ-type); leg screws look empty in IMG_5676/5678 - verify fasteners
posts.bases: black-painted cast-in post bases (CBSQ66-type) on round piers ~12" dia, 4-12" above grade (IMG_5670 ff.)
posts.knee_braces: about 6x6, 45 deg: outer row single braces at both end posts + 3 Y-braces (both directions); inner row only at the south end post; braces in the plane of the beams. NO bolts, lags or plates visible at either end (all three photo groups) - verify; the 2018 detail: 5/8" x 10" lag each end + LTP4 each side + ECCQ cap

footings.seen: round concrete piers ~12-14" dia, 4-12" above grade, one possible crack/cold joint (inner north pier); the outer piers sit near the top of a ~3' timber retaining wall
footings.design_2018: 12" Quik-Tube pier on a 15" sq x 12" spread footing, 36" min into competent bearing, (4) #4 vert + #3 ties, (2) #4 e.w. in the footing
footings.unknown: as-built footing size/depth for the extension - owner to state (or expose one) ; CRC R403.1.7 slope setbacks apply (36.7 % average slope)

lateral_ties.where: side of one joist at the ledger, IMG_5677 (8 SDS-type screws into the joist, ~1/2" threaded rod through the ledger into the house - anchorage inside not visible)
lateral_ties.code: CRC R507.9.2: 2 devices x 1,500 lb within 24" of each end of the deck (or 4 x 750 lb); 2018 design: DTT2Z @ 4'-0" o.c. max + each end - owner to count and photograph each one

framing.hurricane_ties: Simpson H2.5A at the outer beam (about 10 seen); the inner line uses hangers on a header instead

deck.type: black aluminum posts (pyramid caps), flat top rail, bottom rail/channel, CLEAR GLASS infill panels
deck.mount: fascia-mounted: formed U-cup brackets with side flanges, 2 galvanized hex lags + washers per flange through the PVC fascia into the rim; posts ~5-6' o.c.
deck.product: consistent with TimberTech Impression Rail Express (owner) - confirm system + glass part numbers; ESR-4217 recognizes the fascia bracket into CONCRETE only -> engineered connection on wood; glass must be safety glazing (CRC R308.4.4) - confirm etched mark
deck.notes: black flat straps from the guard line to the fascia (purpose unknown); NE corner bracket plate with an empty hole (IMG_5690); blocking behind the rim at each post not visible - verify
deck.source: photos G1-G3, owner (owner said horizontal cable: the photos show glass)

stair.type: black aluminum posts and top rail with VERTICAL stainless cable, both sides of both flights and the landing
stair.handrail: round black graspable handrail on one side of each flight with looped returns (IMG_5680/5681)

stair.location: north end: the upper flight runs NORTH from the north strip (Y 54-90), 3' clear; a ~3'x3' landing on 4 posts (6x6 PT per the sketch; may be smaller - IMG_5691), then the lower flight turns 90 deg WEST toward the house line and ends on a pad at about Y 8"
stair.stringers: 3 per flight: 3x center stringer (notched) + 2 solid outer stringers (unnotched), Simpson LSCZ-type at the deck header, TA-type tread angles on the outer stringers
stair.base: lower flight sits on a weathered PT plank at grade - no concrete pad seen (2018 design called for a concrete pad) - verify / add pad
flags: upper flight ~9'-7" horizontal with no mid support visible - check the notched center stringer
3' wide and 3'x3' landing are the code minimums - tape them

other_structures: a separate cedar stair with hog-wire panels to a lower deck SOUTH of the main deck (IMG_5688/5689) - confirm whether it is in this permit's scope
history: 2018 deck (~19'-8" x 16'-5", north end, drawn by M. Tepperman, no engineer) per the 2004-2026 aerials; extended to 51'-3" after 2019 (LiDAR 2018-19 shows nothing south of the original).
